O rádio liga ao computador por USB ou Wi: The radio connects to the computer over USB or Wi-Fi for control and over an audio cable for sound; fm-dx-webserver brings it all to the browser.
Esquema do caminho do sinal no topo da p: Diagram of the signal path at the top of the home page.
Versão em L do diagrama remoto, para tel: L-shaped version of the remote diagram, for phone screens.
Diagrama de blocos: antena, sintonizador: Block diagram: antenna, TEF6686 tuner, ESP32 processor, screen, touch, keypad, RTC, USB bridge, audio amplifiers and power.
Arquitetura do DP-666, conforme o esquem: DP-666 architecture, according to DEEPELEC’s schematic V2.5.4 and the official code. The U codes are the schematic references.
Flash de 4 MB: bootloader, tabela de par: 4 MB flash: bootloader, partition table, nvs, otadata, 3072 KB firmware, 896 KB file area and coredump.
Mapa do flash de 4 MB, igual nos pacotes: Map of the 4 MB flash, the same in the analyzed Mod17 and v2.20 packages. nvs holds settings and memory channels; spiffs holds logos, color schemes, wallpapers, names and My settings.
FM estendido de 76,1 a 87,3 MHz, rádios: Extended FM from 76.1 to 87.3 MHz, community radio from 87.4 to 88.0 MHz and FM from 88.1 to 107.9 MHz, in 200 kHz channels with an odd decimal.
Faixas de FM no Brasil, segundo o Ato An: FM bands in Brazil, according to Anatel Act No. 8,104/2022 and Resolution No. 721/2020. Channels are 200 kHz wide and end in an odd decimal (.1, .3, .5, .7, .9). RadCom is the community radio band.
Esquema da tela de abertura: título, log: Diagram of the startup screen: title, logo, firmware version, the message Tuner: !None! in red and three markers at the bottom.
Esquema da tela de abertura com o erro,: Diagram of the startup screen with the error, according to the base code (PE5PVB v2.00) and the Mod17 screen. The logo is left out.
Controle e som pelo computador. O Wi-Fi: Control and sound through the computer. The radio’s Wi-Fi does not carry audio: sound goes by cable to the sound card, and fm-dx-webserver brings control and audio to the browser.
